    Proposition 12.2: normal forms for filtered mesh categories #

    deformation-refinements.tex (prop:characteristic-two-normal-form). Let C = kQ/(r_v) be a finite-dimensional graded category with homogeneous quadratic relations, and choose, in each degree q ≥ 3, homogeneous tuples p_i of degree d_i = q whose classes represent the cokernel of D_{q-1}. Every finite filtered E with gr E = C has a presentation E ≅ kQ/(𝔪^{N+1}, r_v − Σ_i λ_i (p_i)_v) inducing the identification on gr.

    As for Proposition 5.4 (FilteredNormalForm.lean), we prove the proposition for E = ind(mod A) filtered by the radical powers, C = k(Γ_A) and the identification of Proposition 2.6(3). The hypothesis is in spanning form: the image of D_{q-1} and the classes of the retained tuples of degree q span all degree-q mesh families. The proof is the source's: correct the arrow lifts degree by degree, retaining a combination of the p_i in each degree (Lifts.exists_retained_correction); the filtration is finite. The resulting lifts realize kQ → ind(mod A) surjectively, with kernel exactly (𝔪^{N+1}, r_v − Σ_i λ_i (p_i)_v) (normalForm), and agree with the identification on every radical layer.

    Deviation in the injectivity step: the source compares associated gradings; we show directly, degree by degree, that a morphism realized to zero lies in the perturbed ideal, using the injectivity of Proposition 2.6(3) and the homogeneous parts of the mesh ideal.
